task_completion.description: The agent opens the Subsurface application and loads the dive log file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Subsurface application window is visible, showing a list of dives from the file /home/ga/Documents/dives.ssrf.

task_completion.description: The agent identifies or selects dives with a maximum depth strictly greater than 20 meters.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking on or highlighting dive entries where the 'Depth' column shows a value > 20.0m.

task_completion.description: The agent adds the specific tag 'DeepTech' to the identified dives.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Tags' field in the dive information/edit pane contains the text 'DeepTech' for the selected dives.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the modifications to the dive log file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent clicks 'File' > 'Save' or a save icon, or a confirmation message appears indicating the file has been saved.

task_completion.description: The final saved file is located at the correct path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The window title bar or the 'Save As' dialog confirms the file path is /home/ga/Documents/dives.ssrf.

integrity.description: The agent used the Subsurface GUI to filter and tag, rather than command-line tools like sed or awk.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Subsurface application menus and input fields.

integrity.description: The agent did not open the .ssrf file in a text editor to manually add tags.
integrity.visual_evidence: No text editors (like Gedit or Vim) are seen displaying the raw XML content of the .ssrf file.

integrity.description: The agent correctly distinguished between dives > 20m and those <= 20m.
integrity.visual_evidence: Dives with depths like 18m or 20m do not have the 'DeepTech' tag applied in the UI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use the Subsurface GUI. The depth threshold is strictly > 20.0 meters. The exact tag to be added is 'DeepTech' (case-sensitive). The target file path is /home/ga/Documents/dives.ssrf. Ensure the agent does not tag dives that are exactly 20.0 meters deep.
